question: In which sport did India win its first individual Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wrestling**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first individual Olympic medal was won by Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav in the sport of **wrestling**.
 
• He won the bronze medal in the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
• Khashaba Jadhav competed in the freestyle bantamweight category.
 
• This achievement marked a significant milestone for India in the Olympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Games:**

 
 
• The Olympic Games are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• Thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
 
 
• **Freestyle Wrestling:**
 
 
• Freestyle wrestling is a style of amateur wrestling that is practiced worldwide.
 
• It is one of the two wrestling disciplines featured in the Olympic Games, the other being Greco-Roman.
 
• In freestyle wrestling, competitors are allowed to use their legs for both offense and defense, which differentiates it from Greco-Roman wrestling.
 
 
 
• **Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav:**
 
 
• Khashaba Jadhav was an Indian wrestler who competed in the 1948 London Olympics and the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
• He is remembered for his remarkable achievement in the 1952 Helsinki Olympics, where he won the bronze medal.
 
• Jadhav's victory was a historic moment for India, bringing the country its first individual Olympic medal.
